newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BCP wins Brazil Sao Paulo B Band concession.
newsitem.headline: BCP wins Brazil Sao Paulo B Band concession.

text.p: The BCP SA consortium of U.S. telecommunications operator BellSouth Corp was awarded the 20-year concession to run cellular B Band services in metropolitan Sao Paulo Wednesday, Brazilian officials said.

Officials of the Communications Ministry said BCP offered 2.647 billion reais, way above the 600 million reais minimum price set for what is generally regarded as the filet mignon among the 10 cellular B Band concessions up for grabs.
In addition to BellSouth, the BCP consortium consists of Brazil's Banco Safra, Brazilian media group Estado de Sao Paulo and telecommunications operator Splice do Brasil.
The Communications Ministry was also due Wednesday to announce the winner for the Band B cellular concession in the Bahia and Sergipe states service area.
